name: desk-triage
description: Triage the open support tickets: set priorities and draft replies, a person approves, then the drafts are added to the tickets.

focus.description: Which tickets (e.g. "urgent ones", "from acme.com"); empty for every open ticket

triage.title: Triage and draft
triage.prompt:
Triage the open tickets on the customer desk (which ones, if it says: {{input.focus}}). Set priorities now, but do not add any reply yet: for each ticket that can be answered, include the draft reply in your report under its id.
Feedback from the reviewer, if any: {{feedback}}

approve.title: Check the drafts
approve.message:
Add these replies to their tickets?

{{state.triage}}

add.title: Add the replies
add.prompt:
Add each approved draft reply below to its ticket with desk_ticket_update (reply, status "waiting"), exactly as written.

{{state.triage}}
